title: My stats
subtitle: Your matches, your champions, your roles.

locked.title: Link a Riot account to open this screen
locked.description: Without a linked account there is nothing to compute: statistics are built from your matches, and nothing tells us which ones are yours.

pending.title: Your Riot ID is awaiting confirmation
pending.description: It is saved, but we could not confirm it with Riot yet. Collection starts as soon as that is done.

waiting.title: Your data is on its way
waiting.description: The first collection walks through your whole history. It is slow once, and only once.

unavailable.title: Progress unavailable
unavailable.description: The Riot connector is not answering. Your data is not lost, but we cannot say how far the collection has got.

soon.title: Statistics are coming
soon.description: Your account is linked and your matches are being collected. The screens that use them come in a later batch.
